description_en: Modifies the SSL configuration of an RDS AI application instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS AI应用实例的SSL配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-instance-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name ra-supabase-8moov5lxba0000 --ssl-enabled 1 --ca-type custom --server-cert -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000QqEP-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --server-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----MIIE0000ihfg==-----END_PRIVATE_KEY----- --branch-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the AI application
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Currently, only custom is supported, which indicates that a custom certificate is used.
This parameter is required when SSLEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型，当前仅支持custom，表示使用自定义证书。
SSLEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: ca_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate content.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
自定义证书内容。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the certificate.

This parameter is required when CAType is set to custom
parameters.help_zh:
证书私钥。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_key
